_about: Verdicts for sparql/cases.json (echochamber CLAUDE.md rule 2). A case listed here must NOT meet the RDF4J expectation; when it does, the suite fails and the verdict must be revised. Original to echochamber, Apache-2.0.

testcases-sparql-1.1/bindings#sparql11-b.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §19.8 [7] ValuesClause (REC keyword VALUES; BINDINGS is the working-draft keyword used until 2012)
testcases-sparql-1.1/bindings#sparql11-b.note: RDF4J's parser still accepts BINDINGS; Factoidal answers query.syntax.

testcases-sparql-1.1/property-paths#spar.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §9.1 and §19.8 [93] PathMod ('?' | '*' | '+'); the {n,m} forms were removed after the 2010 working drafts

testcases-sparql-1.1/builtin#sparql11-no.note: Factoidal keeps :book4 ("no discount") and :book5 ("70"), whose comparisons with 700 are errors.

testcases-sparql-1.1/aggregates#sparql11.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.1 and §18.5 (Sum is op:numeric-add; the lexical form of the result is not fixed)
testcases-sparql-1.1/aggregates#sparql11.note: RDF4J expects "10.0"^^xsd:decimal; Factoidal gives "10"^^xsd:decimal (the XSD 1.1 canonical form). Same value and datatype. Factoidal is inconsistent with itself here: AVG gives "7.0".

testcases-sparql-1.1/aggregates#sparql11.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.1 and §18.5 (Avg is Sum/Count; lexical form not fixed)
testcases-sparql-1.1/aggregates#sparql11.note: RDF4J expects "7"^^xsd:decimal; Factoidal gives "7.0"^^xsd:decimal. Same value and datatype.
